purpose: the game-specific half of the job pipeline, as the five hook names of warscape/hooks.py: the found-path rule for briefs (row 80, J11) and its registry-gap count on the `jobs check` line, rule 76 (every core candidate folder has a promotion job), rule 79 (on every branch kind, J73: a change to proxy/ or harness/, or a core pin that changes the core's own proxy/ or harness/, needs 20 consecutive acceptance passes on the final build, J4, J44, J45, J58; J75: each counted line's committed evidence is unique and agrees with it, the ledger diff is append-only, base pass files are immutable, only ledger.jsonl is exempt, and the shas the pinned core names are required), the UI baseline and lock rules (J80: a change to uikit/napoleon/baseline.json or baseline/ needs the reviewer's `Baseline accepted: <sha>` line, and a job never writes LOCK.json) and the PC line of the status page (rule 75, J44; its usage half J49: Claude usage read from Claude Code's own local transcripts by tools/usage_reader.py, read-only, no conversation text, cost shown as an estimate)
usage: not run by hand: `python3 core/wsc.py jobs check|view` and `python3 core/wsc.py policy --branch <branch>` call it; `python3 -m unittest tests.test_jobs_hooks` tests it
when: automatic, through wsc.toml [jobs] hooks; edit it when one of those rules changes (rules 76 and 79 in docs/plans/PLAN.md section 4, the J5 ledger)
not_a_verb: a hook module the core's jobs and policy verbs import; it has no command line of its own
